title: UNSIGNED MINIATURE PORTRAIT IN GILT FRAME
description: UNSIGNED MINIATURE PORTRAIT IN GILT FRAME - DETAILS ON VERSO - 8.5CM (H) X 6.5CM (W)
findings: Small bearded man in red cardinal-style robes, thickly painted, naive/copy-like handling. Gilt frame heavy and chipped. Verso not photographed.
condition: Frame losses and wear to gilt; surface grimy.
reason: Unsigned, crude later copy of an old-master style portrait.

title: PRO HART HAND COLOURED ETCHING
description: PRO HART HAND COLOURED ETCHING - BAR SCENE - LTD EDN 14/100 - SIGNED LOWER RIGHT - 15.5CM (H) X 20CM (W)
findings: Hand coloured etching of a bar scene with signature 'Pro Hart' in pencil lower right and '14/100' edition number lower left, both legible. Signature looks in keeping with his usual cartoon-style hand. Framed with dark mat.
condition: Clean, no visible foxing or damage.
reason: Pro Hart signed and numbered limited edition, collectable Australian name with steady market.

title: UNSIGNED GILT FRAMED PASTEL
description: UNSIGNED GILT FRAMED PASTEL - PORTRAIT OF LADY WITH FLOWERS - 61.5CM (H) X 50.5CM (W) - SOME DAMAGE TO CANVAS
findings: Pastel/chalk portrait of a young woman in 18th-century dress with flowers, pearl earrings and bracelet, in carved gilt frame. Style is 18th century English, pastel appears on canvas or rough paper. Unsigned, no verso shown.
condition: Flaking and loss visible to face and dress, worn surface, canvas texture showing through, frame chipped.
reason: Possibly genuinely 18th century portrait, or a later copy; under-described and worth an expert look.

title: NYAKUL DAWSON DOT ACRYLIC ON LINEN
description: NYAKUL DAWSON DOT ACRYLIC ON LINEN - IRRUNYTJU 2003 - INFORMATION ON VERSO - 81.5CM (H) X 119.8CM (W)
findings: Dot painting with verso inscription 'IRRND03005 / Nyakul Dawson / Irrunytju 2003' on canvas turnover (Irrunytju Arts style code). Unframed on stretcher, red and green dotwork, good density. Photo 4 shows clean stretcher with no visible gallery label or COA.
reason: Nyakul Dawson (Irrunytju/Wingellina) large canvas 2003 with art centre style inscription; established artist, likely well over $500.

title: L BURLEIGH BRUHL WATERCOLOUR
description: L BURLEIGH BRUHL WATERCOLOUR - RIVER SCENE - SIGNED LOWER LEFT - 50.5CM (H) X 32CM (W)

reason: Known Burleigh Bruhl (Lawrence Burleigh Bruhl, English, 1900s) European town scene watercolour; modest but collectable.

title: WYKEHAM PERRY OIL ON BOARD
description: WYKEHAM PERRY OIL ON BOARD - WALKING THROUGH THE TREES - SIGNED LOWER RIGHT - 40CM (H) X 28.5CM (W)

condition: Good, canvas board texture visible, no damage.
reason: Wykeham Perry (Australian impressionist landscape painter) signed oil, decent quality.

title: DAVID BROMLEY MIXED MEDIA
description: DAVID BROMLEY MIXED MEDIA - LADY - SIGNED LOWER LEFT - 41CM (H) X 29CM (W)
findings: Red and black expressive female nude on paper, framed. Signature reads vertically 'BROML...' lower left, in what looks like a marker/brush, letters not typical of clear Bromley signature. Looks like a Bromley pastiche or a quick sketch.
reason: David Bromley name; attribution should be treated sceptically (signature rough, style generic) but genuine works sell well.

title: RICHARD BACON WATERCOLOUR

reason: Larger Wykeham Perry signed oil, good composition.

title: 19TH CENTURY MOULDED MUSK FRAMED PORTRAIT

reason: Barbizon-style oil with name on verso not shown; could be attributed to a listed artist, uncertain.

condition: Frame slightly worn, back board split.
reason: Chinese export reverse glass paintings have a steady market; age unverified.

title: RICHARD BACON WATERCOLOUR

title: H.K. ROOKE OIL ON CANVAS

reason: H.K. Rooke RBA (Harry Kingsley Rooke, English exhibitor) with signature and label; solid provenance for a decorative Norwegian scene.
